title: Auslander–Buchsbaum depth formula
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring (a ring with exactly one maximal ideal) [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $M$ be a nonzero finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] of finite projective dimension [def-weil-pbc-finite-global-dimension]. Then $$\operatorname{depth}(R)=\operatorname{pd}_R(M)+\operatorname{depth}(M),$$ where depths are taken with respect to $\mathfrak m$ [def-weil-pbc-depth].
